data.subject: A client project across 16 weeks
data.preview_text: See how undated monthly, weekly and daily pages could hold the work.
data.body:
If a substantial client project needs a defined place away from screens, 16 weeks offers a clear frame for deciding what belongs within it.

Papier’s Your Plans on Paper is a softback spiral productivity planner with 16 weeks of undated pages. Goal breakdowns give the work its shape before it meets the calendar.

Monthly, weekly and daily planning pages then let you consider the project at different horizons — from its wider arc to the work for a given day.

The product page’s Look inside view lets you flick through the planner and inspect those formats before deciding whether they fit the way you want to organise the project.
